about: A living director (patch and arm variants, mood poses) stepped every 1/60 s: at step n, t = n/60, set_level(the last `levels` entry at or before t), then update(1/60, inputs at t). Inputs: phase and the idle time of the last `phases` entry at or before t (idle = its idle time + t - its start + every idleJumps amount whose time is at or before t, only while idle); wait = t - start of a request with start <= t < first, else null; cursor linear between `cursor` keys (t, x, y) and null outside them; over = cursor inside `over` [x0, x1, y0, y1]; events and clicks fire at the step whose (t - 1/60, t] holds their time, a click only while over. Frames hold every 20th step; values as director.json (1e-4); mood, pose, face, gaze, mouth and gesture exactly.
